text:
I'll help you find the bakery. Let me start by looking around to get oriented.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="mud_command">
<parameter name="command">look</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="mud_command">
<parameter name="command">ask guard about bakery</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Let me get a proper look at my surroundings first:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="mud_command">
<parameter name="command">look</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Once I see what's around, I can explore systematically. Could you tell me:
- What zone/city are we in?
- Is there a bakery quest or just exploring?

I'll scout the area and navigate toward any shops or populated areas where a bakery is likely to be located.

text:
I'll navigate to the market square and search for the bakery there.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="mud_command">
<parameter name="command">look</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="mud_command">
<parameter name="command">north</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Let me look around once I arrive:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="mud_command">
<parameter name="command">look</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

If I don't see a bakery directly, I'll try:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="mud_command">
<parameter name="command">say where is the bakery</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Let me know what shows up in these observations and I can navigate more precisely to locate the bakery in the market square.
